```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
red <- rast("data/LC09_L2SP_044033_20250714_20250716_02_T1/LC09_L2SP_044033_20250714_20250716_02_T1_SR_B4.tif")

nir <- rast("data/LC09_L2SP_044033_20250714_20250716_02_T1/LC09_L2SP_044033_20250714_20250716_02_T1_SR_B5.tif")

swir1 <- rast("data/LC09_L2SP_044033_20250714_20250716_02_T1/LC09_L2SP_044033_20250714_20250716_02_T1_SR_B6.tif")

thermal <- rast("data/LC09_L2SP_044033_20250714_20250716_02_T1/LC09_L2SP_044033_20250714_20250716_02_T1_ST_B10.tif")

cities <- st_read("data/California_Cities_and_Identifiers_Blue_Version_view_-3024944392275494958/California_City_Boundaries_and_Identifiers.shp")
```

```{r}
landsat_bands <- c(red, nir, swir1, thermal)

names(landsat_bands) <- c("red","nir", "swir1", "thermal")

NDVI <- ((nir - red) / (nir + red))

NDBI <- ((swir1 - nir) / (swir1 + nir))

landsat_stack <- c(NDVI, NDBI, thermal)
names(landsat_stack) <- c("NDVI", "NDBI", "Thermal")

chico <- cities %>%
  filter(CDTFA_CITY == "Chico") %>%
  select("GNIS_ID")

chico_reproject <- vect(chico)

chico_reproject <- project(chico_reproject, crs(landsat_stack))
landsat_chico <- crop(landsat_stack, chico_reproject)
landsat_chico <- mask(landsat_chico, chico_reproject)

landsat_chico_df <- as.data.frame(landsat_chico, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
glimpse(landsat_chico_df)

plot(
  landsat_chico,
  fun = function() {
    lines(chico_reproject)
  }
)

landsat_chico_df <- as.data.frame(landsat_chico, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
glimpse(landsat_chico_df)
```
